scientific_scope: A retrospective, preregistered sequence-independent position-field comparator for the already frozen RK08 velocity-proxy predictions. This analysis cannot reverse the original negative cross-study mechanism result or open RK-G1.

constant_field.name: train_relative_position_20bin_transcript_balanced_constant
constant_field.estimator: Within each training transcript, average observed targets within each relative-position bin; then average those transcript-bin means equally across training transcripts.
constant_field.missing_bin_fallback: Equal-weight mean of per-transcript mean targets across all training transcripts.

comparison_rules.better_direction: Lower transcript-balanced MSE and higher mean transcript Pearson are better.
comparison_rules.pearson_rows: For each paired comparison, use transcripts with finite Pearson values for both compared predictors.
comparison_rules.shared_indices: For a given comparison and seed, the same transcript resample is used for both endpoints; resetting the same seed for each comparison gives aligned transcript resamples across comparisons.
comparison_rules.confidence_interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of paired bootstrap delta
comparison_rules.multiplicity: Holm across all six primary endpoint-comparison p-values
comparison_rules.sensitivity_rule: For support, the bootstrap mean delta must have the beneficial direction at both sensitivity seeds.

support_rules.model_minus_constant_supported: Both endpoint Holm p<0.05; MSE CI high<0; Pearson CI low>0; both sensitivity seeds have beneficial directions.
support_rules.ridge_minus_constant_supported: Both endpoint Holm p<0.05; MSE CI high<0; Pearson CI low>0; both sensitivity seeds have beneficial directions.
support_rules.model_minus_ridge_supported: Both endpoint Holm p<0.05; MSE CI high<0; Pearson CI low>0; both sensitivity seeds have beneficial directions.

boundaries.target_semantics: occupancy-derived speed proxy, not physical velocity
boundaries.primary_ood: Subtelny14 is cross-study/cross-species and exact-CDS-disjoint from all Mohammad16 splits; it is not homology-cluster OOD.
boundaries.rule: Even a significant improvement over the constant field does not establish transferable mechanism, causal velocity regulation, protein-OOD function, or generation readiness.
